motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Single tempo for every state transition — color, background, border, progress fill, drawer reveal.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: The only looping animation in the system: loading-skeleton breathing.

motion.name: count-flash
motion.purpose: One-beat acknowledgment when a live count changes; initial load does not flash.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion collapses to effectively zero; no animation is load-bearing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single ink-filled CTA; reserved for the one confirm-style action per surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 2; background: #201d1d; color: #fdfcfc; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 20px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0f0000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #201d1d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #f1eeee; color: #9a9898; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined hairline-strong alternative for every non-confirm action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 2; background: #fdfcfc; color: #201d1d; border: 1px solid #646262; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 20px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #f8f7f7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #201d1d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: #f1eeee; border-color: transparent; color: #9a9898; cursor: default; }

components.name: Man-Page Count Row
components.description: Key–value data row: mute label, dotted ash leader on the baseline, tabular ink numeral that flashes accent on change.
components.css: .ds-count-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-count-row-label { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #646262; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-count-row-leader { flex: 1; min-width: 16px; border-bottom: 1px dotted #9a9898; } .ds-count-row-value { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: #201d1d; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-count-row-value.flash { animation: ds-count-flash 180ms ease-out; } @keyframes ds-count-flash { from { color: #007aff; } to { color: #201d1d; } }

components.name: Dark Title Bar
components.description: The single dark moment of a small chrome surface: surface-dark strip with wordmark at left, login-state dot + metadata at right.
components.html: 单词雷达 (1)已登录
components.css: .ds-title-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: #201d1d; color: #fdfcfc; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-title-bar-brand { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #fdfcfc; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-title-bar-login { position: relative; display: block; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #9a9898; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-title-bar-login::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; translate: 0 -50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9a9898; } .ds-title-bar-login[data-state="logged-in"]::before { background: #30d158; } .ds-title-bar-login[data-state="logged-out"]::before { background: #ff3b30; }

components.name: Push Progress
components.description: Flat status progress: hairline track, solid accent fill advanced by transform scaleX, never by width.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(15, 0, 0, 0.12); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #007aff; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms ease-out; }

components.name: Tools Disclosure Toggle
components.description: ASCII-bracket disclosure toggle: [+]/[-] in a fixed 3ch slot, mute label that deepens to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-tools-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 0; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 2; color: #646262; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-tools-toggle:hover { color: #201d1d; } .ds-tools-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #201d1d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tools-marker { display: inline-block; min-width: 3ch; }

components.name: Skeleton Pulse
components.description: Loading placeholder: hairline block breathing between opacity 1 and 0.45; dark variant for the surface-dark title bar.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { display: inline-block; min-width: 2.5em; height: 0.8em; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(15, 0, 0, 0.12); animation: ds-skeleton-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-skeleton--dark { background: rgb(253 252 252 / 0.16); } @keyframes ds-skeleton-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.45; } }

components.name: Link Button
components.description: Footer-edge text action: ink underline link that rests to ash and loses its underline when disabled.
components.css: .ds-link-btn { appearance: none; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 0; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 2; color: #201d1d; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-link-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #302c2c; } .ds-link-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #201d1d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-link-btn:disabled { color: #9a9898; text-decoration: none; cursor: default; }

rules.name: The Text-Deepens Rule
rules.body: Semantic color used as text on the cream canvas always takes the deepened `-hover` step — `accent-hover` (6.88:1), `danger-hover` (5.26:1), `success-hover` (4.96:1), all ≥ AA at body sizes. The ramp originals fail 4.5:1 on cream (`accent` 3.92:1, `danger` 3.46:1, `success` 1.97:1) and are reserved for non-text carriers: status dots, progress fills, and markers. Text deepens; dots and bars keep the bright original.

rules.name: The One Dark Moment Rule
rules.body: Exactly one inverted-dark region per surface. On landing pages it is the full-bleed hero TUI mockup; on small chrome surfaces (a browser-action popup, a settings drawer) it is the title bar — a `surface-dark` strip carrying wordmark and status metadata. Dark is never used for body content, and a surface never carries two dark regions.

rules.name: The Single Tempo Rule
rules.body: 180ms ease-out for every state change. No second duration, no easing zoo. Where hover feedback exists it is a color-only shift within the gray ladder (mute → ink on toggles, ink → charcoal on links); nothing moves, lifts, glows, or scales on interaction.
